harness: src/eval/exacc.py, run as: venv/bin/python -m src.eval.exacc --model <model> --file <split jsonl> --db <orders|cars>

metric.execution_accuracy: predicted SQL is executed on the fixture named by the row's db_id and its result set compared with the gold result set (multiset unless the gold has ORDER BY)
metric.valid_sql_rate: prediction executed without error; currently means 'it ran', not 'it parses' (no sqlglot check yet)

interval.method: normal approximation, NOT the bootstrap the roadmap requires
interval.note: quote as 'roughly a quarter, between ~16 % and ~36 %'

nondeterminism.observation: the same epoch-4 weights scored 46/60 (earlier run) and 47/60 (logged run) on dev
candidate_causes: artifacts/sft_v1 stores the weights in fp32 while checkpoint-84 stores bf16 (308/308 tensors match, max abs diff 2.2e-4 = one bf16 ulp)

base_model_behaviour.observed: answers in English prose, e.g. 'The average daily rate of the fleet is 1000.'; one logged failure per split is an empty prediction caused by extract() splitting on '###'
base_model_behaviour.caveat: raw generations are not printed by the harness, so the empty-prediction case is not fully explained

dev.gold: SELECT name FROM user WHERE created_at >= '2000-01-01'
dev.pred: SELECT name, email FROM user WHERE created_at > '2000-01-01'

dev.category: dropped ORDER BY tiebreaker + extra column
dev.gold: SELECT name, email FROM user ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 5
dev.pred: SELECT name, email, created_at FROM user ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 5

dev.gold: SELECT id, quantity, created_at FROM user_orders ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 5
dev.pred: SELECT id, created_at FROM user_orders ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 5

test_in.gold: SELECT name, email FROM user ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
test_in.pred: SELECT name, email, created_at FROM user ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 1

test_in.gold: SELECT id, quantity FROM user_orders WHERE item_id = 18
test_in.pred: SELECT id FROM user_orders WHERE item_id = 18

test_in.gold: SELECT name, price, stock FROM item WHERE stock > 5 ORDER BY price DESC, id LIMIT 5
test_in.pred: SELECT item.name, item.price FROM item WHERE item.stock > 5 ORDER BY item.price DESC, item.id LIMIT 5

test_out.category: wrong target column for the filter value + wrong projection
test_out.gold: SELECT car.make, car.model, dealership.name AS dealership_name FROM car JOIN dealership ON car.dealership_id = dealership.id WHERE dealership.city = 'New Danielborough'
test_out.pred: SELECT car.vin, car.daily_rate FROM car JOIN dealership ON car.dealership_id = dealership.id WHERE dealership.name LIKE 'New Danielborough%'

test_out.category: aggregate scope changed (global to per-group) + extra columns
test_out.gold: SELECT make, model FROM car WHERE daily_rate > (SELECT AVG(daily_rate) FROM car)
test_out.pred: SELECT car.make, car.model, car.year, car.vin, car.daily_rate FROM car WHERE car.daily_rate > (SELECT AVG(x.daily_rate) FROM car AS x WHERE x.dealership_id = car.dealership_id)

test_out.category: wrong query shape (GROUP BY instead of LIMIT/OFFSET)
test_out.gold: SELECT make, model, daily_rate FROM car ORDER BY daily_rate DESC, id LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
test_out.pred: SELECT dealership_id, MAX(daily_rate) FROM car GROUP BY dealership_id ORDER BY daily_rate DESC, dealership_id LIMIT 1
